extDescription.message: A lightweight AI browser assistant that reads, fills and checks web pages for you, using the model you choose.

spNewChatTitle.message: End the current task and enter a new goal

spWelcomeTitle.message: Leave the browser work to me

spWelcomeText.message: Find pages, read content, fill in forms — start with one sentence.

spScopeHint.message: The assistant opens websites as the task needs and asks only when browser site permission is missing.

spMembersHint.message: Added tabs belong to this task and other tasks cannot use them; the assistant still reads and acts only in the working tab. Removing a tab does not close it.

spSensitiveTitle.message: Allow sensitive fields in this conversation?

spSensitiveText.message: If allowed, passwords, verification codes, card numbers and security codes may be sent to your configured model service and kept with the task record for this browser session. This applies to this conversation only and does not authorize subscriptions or payments.

spBrowserTargetText.message: Task unfinished: the target site is not open yet and needs browser site permission.

spPlanHint.message: "Verified" reflects the page when it was recorded; final results need fresh verification.

spHistoryNote.message: Conversations for this tab and site; kept only for this browser session

spPlaceholderNew.message: Tell me what you want to do…

spComposerHint.message: Enter to send, Shift + Enter for a new line

spComposerNote.message: Content goes to your chosen model · Tasks keep running after you close the panel

optIntro.message: Configure the default model and assistant behavior here. After you send a message, the assistant reads the current page and calls the model several times during the task. API permission and website access permission are separate.

optReasoningHint.message: Sends reasoning_effort to request a reasoning level; the effect depends on the model service. If the API does not support it, choose Service default. Reasoning may add time and cost.

optToolModeAuto.message: Auto (default): native tool calls, JSON when unsupported

optToolModeHint.message: Auto sends tools first; if the API rejects them or does not call a tool, it remembers this model and switches to strict JSON text. Saving settings again retries native tool calls.

optSaveConnection.message: Allow this API URL and save

optConnectionHint.message: Only HTTPS, or HTTP on localhost / 127.0.0.1 / [::1], is allowed. The key is stored only in this device's chrome.storage.local, is not synced and is never passed to page content scripts; local storage is not an encrypted vault.

optMaxStepsHint.message: With no limit, a task runs until it completes, pauses, hits an error or you click Stop. You can also enter a custom limit such as 50 or 500. Each round calls the model; the round count carries over across page changes.

optInputChars.message: Characters per side panel message (default 2000, range 100–10000)

optInputCharsHint.message: Limits each task or follow-up you send. Follow-ups may total the larger of 12000 or 6× the per-message limit. Longer content uses more context and cost per round.

optCompression.message: Auto-compaction threshold (% of available input budget)

optContextHint.message: Enter the context window your model actually supports (default 100000 tokens). 2000 tokens are reserved for output, and compaction starts at 80% of the remaining budget. Usage is estimated when the API does not report it. Normal runs keep the raw history to help cache reuse; cache hits depend on the provider.

optAutoHint.message: Filling, checking, selecting and clicking run automatically, with no switches or per-step confirmation. You can stop at any time; page actions already sent are not undone.

optManagementHint.message: Choose an open page. Editing or clearing memory cancels related pending requests and pauses related tasks; continue them from the side panel.

optSiteMemoryHint.message: Stored only on this device and available for the same site across tabs and browser restarts. The model maintains it as needed and never saves whole conversations automatically. Check that notes still apply when you switch accounts.

optGlobalMemoryHint.message: Stores preferences and general lessons that apply across sites, on this device only, across tabs and browser restarts. You can view, edit or add notes; changes pause related tasks on every site. Keep site-specific procedures in site memory.

optTempMemoryHint.message: The model decides what to save, read and clean up. Memory is limited to the current tab and site and is cleared when the tab closes; you can also clear it at any time.

optAppearanceHint.message: Sets the image shown in new conversations. It saves automatically and open side panels update.

optImageHint.message: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 5 MB and 8192 px per side. Transparent backgrounds look best; images are scaled down to 1024 px on the longest side. Stored only on this device and never sent to the model.

optFooter.message: Your model · Local memory · Your control

spTabUnreadable.message: Can't read the current tab. Reopen the side panel.

spScopeCanceled.message: Site permission canceled; task scope unchanged

spScopeTaskChanged.message: The task changed; the permission was not added to the new task

spScopeInvalid.message: Enter an HTTP/HTTPS site origin without a path, query or credentials

spMemberRemoved.message: Tab removed from the task; the page stays open.

spDiagnosticsExported.message: Exported task stats without the goal, page or form content

spGrantCanceled.message: You canceled site permission; the page is not connected

spLegacyRequest.message: Older record did not save full parameters

spPendingResult.message: Action prepared or sent; waiting for the tool result

spContextUsage.message: Last request input {1} tokens · cached {2} tokens

spNoResults.message: No tool results yet; status messages are below.

spResultsHint.message: Actions and checks appear here once a task starts.

spPlaceholderOngoing.message: Add details or tell me the next step…

spScopeUpdated.message: Task scope updated and the task paused; review it, then click Continue.

spGrantedAll.message: All regular sites allowed; the current page is connected.

spGrantedSite.message: Site allowed and connected; you can start or continue a task.

optInvalidConfig.message: Enter a valid model, key and language

optApiDenied.message: API permission denied; settings not saved

optApiSaved.message: API settings saved; no model call has been made yet. Allow website access separately.

optBehaviorSaved.message: Assistant defaults saved; they apply to new tasks or after you click Continue task.

optLoaded.message: Settings loaded. The API and websites are authorized separately.

optLoadFailed.message: Can't read settings. Restart the extension and try again.

mgSiteUpdated.message: Site memory updated; related running tasks are paused — click Continue to resume.

mgTempCleared.message: Temporary memory cleared; related tasks are paused.

mgNoTabs.message: Open a regular HTTP/HTTPS page first, then refresh the list.

mgSiteEmpty.message: No long-term memory for this site

gmUpdated.message: Global memory updated; related running tasks are paused — click Continue to resume.

wiReadFailed.message: Can't read the image setting; showing the default image for now.

wiType.message: Choose a PNG, JPG or WebP image.

wiSize.message: The image must be 5 MB or smaller.

wiDecode.message: Can't read this image; choose another one.

wiDimensions.message: Each side of the image must be 8192 px or less.

wiTooLarge.message: The saved image exceeds 2 MB; choose a smaller or simpler image.

wiSaved.message: Image saved and applied to the side panel. It is stored only on this device.

wiSaveFailed.message: Couldn't save the image; please try again.

spScriptText.message: The script runs inside this page and can read and change its content; its return value is sent to your configured model service. Approving runs it once. Read the full code first.

spScriptWorldUser.message: isolated (USER_SCRIPT, can use the page DOM)

spScriptWorldMain.message: page main world (MAIN, can access the page's own JavaScript variables)

optScriptsIntro.message: When enabled, the assistant may write JavaScript and run it in the current page (run_script) when the normal tools cannot do the job. Before every run the side panel shows the full code, target site and environment, and nothing runs until you approve that one run; if you reject it, the assistant tries another way. Return values are sent to your configured model service.

optScriptsToggle.message: After allowing, also turn on "Allow User Scripts" for this extension under chrome://extensions → Details (Chrome 138 and later); on Chrome 135–137 turn on "Developer mode" at the top right of the extensions page instead. Chrome versions below 135 are not supported.

optScriptsReady.message: Enabled: the model can ask to run scripts, and each run needs your approval in the side panel.

optScriptsNeedToggle.message: Permission granted, but the browser does not allow user scripts yet: turn on "Allow User Scripts" in the extension details ("Developer mode" on Chrome 135–137) and make sure Chrome is version 135 or later.

optScriptsOff.message: Off: the model does not see the script tool.

optScriptsDenied.message: Script execution permission was not granted.

optScriptsRevokeFailed.message: Could not revoke. Remove the permission on the extension details page.

optScriptsDetailsFailed.message: Could not open the extension details page. Visit chrome://extensions manually.

optScriptsDevReady.message: Developer build: script permission is built in and scripts run without confirmation.

optScriptsDevToggle.message: Developer build: script permission is built in, but the browser does not allow user scripts yet. Turn on "Allow User Scripts" in the extension details.
